newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-GOLOTA TO FIGHT MERCER AT MADISON SQUARE GARDEN IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-GOLOTA TO FIGHT MERCER AT MADISON SQUARE GARDEN IN MAY.

text.p: Andrew Golota, whose disqualification against Riddick Bowe last July at Madison Square Garden resulted in a full-scale brawl, will return to the famed New York arena on May 16 to fight Ray Mercer.
Golota, a native of Poland, was disqualified for throwing low blows in his July 11 heavyweight bout with Bowe in New York, sparking a riot that resulted in numerous arrests.
In their Atlantic City rematch in December, Golota was again decisively leading Bowe when, incredibly, he was disqualified again for low blows. Golota is 28-2 with 25 knockouts.
Mercer is 24-4-1 with 16 knockouts. He has two losses and a draw in his last four fights.
The undercard will feature Tim Witherspoon (45-5, 30 knockouts) against an opponent to be named.
